message.create_bioships.dormant: Dormant. Assemble this core into a Sable structure to awaken it.
message.create_bioships.secondary: Only one living core can lead this structure. Separate the extra cores.

message.create_bioships.controls_enabled: The ship listens to its nerve controls. Touch the core to rest again.
